title: Siemens TeleControl Server Basic Authenticate SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Siemens TeleControl Server Basic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the Authenticate method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
